problem_summary: 5 citizen complaints about 'Fixing/Reparing Potholes' were recorded in Bilekahalli between May 2019 and December 2020, spanning 2 calendar year(s). 40% of these complaints remain unresolved (status: Open or Re-opened).

evidence_items.source: I Change My City (ichangemycity.com) via OpenCity

evidence_items.description: KAUN 2022 data: ward recorded 156 pothole complaints.
25 road/drain work order(s) sanctioned in ward (₹10.1 crore, FY 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26). Note: work order ward mapping uses datameet243 numbering (fuzzy_name join).

agency_attribution_note: 5 of 5 complaints explicitly name BBMP as the responsible agency in the source data.
priority_rationale: Priority tier LOW (score=0.31). Top scoring factors: recurrence_years=0.67, unresolved_rate=0.40, description_severity=0.18.
ward_join_note: ICMC ward_name='Bilekahalli' matched to datameet243=240 via fuzzy_name (overlap_confidence=0.505).
recommended_next_steps: File an RTI (Right to Information) request to BBMP requesting the road repair history for Bilekahalli for the period 2019–2020.
Request inspection records for the 25 work order(s) sanctioned in this ward to verify whether road works covered the affected stretch.
Re-survey affected stretch using a civic volunteer or journalist to document current road condition.

representative_complaints.description_excerpt:
I travel daily to my college through Bannerghatta road I find so many potholes which are not visible when it rains 
I have also met an accident due to this

On the road beside IIM which is connecting Bannerghatta main road and Ayyappa Swamy temple road in Arekere has bigger potholes. On this road it is becoming difficult to drive the 4 wheelers and 2 wheelers. 
It is causing accidents on this road. Please fix potholes issue on this toad
Road not proper...Potholes leading to traffic block from Bilekahalli --- IIM --- HSBC ---- Till Arekere

Back gate entry of apollo has potholes deep and debris all over spread in middle of road. It becomes difficult for critical patients to travel in car or ambulance. This has been for last 3-4 months and no one bothered. Please fix potholes as patients travel through this gate.

While the footpath was done last year, it is very high and uneven. For elderly people, for the disabled and people with arthritis- it is very difficult to climb on the pavement. And once we climb on to the pavement, every few feet because of shops entrance, the footpath drops by nearly 9-12 inches,
